note: PAR's ATC is split by subset ([[identity.split]]): PAR_OV and PAR_SV go to one owner, PAR_TV to another. A carry names the native ATC on PAR_OV. A carry targets the unsplit native variable, so it is refused as stale at its own entry, and both split owners keep their documented 2001-2020 states.
fails_if: `compile_occurrence_corrections` admits a carry on a split native variable (the added occurrence has no split owner: an unlocated unresolved_catalog_identity withholds the catalog, and no stale issue names the carry)
